title: agctl codex doctor report, version 1
description: What `agctl codex doctor --json` emits (plan section 3.3, AC108). Every string here is an identifier agctl validated, a path agctl derived, a word this build compiled in, or a rendered number: no member name, no configuration value and no line of `config.toml` reaches a field, and no token, key or claim outside the allowlist appears anywhere (invariants I24 and I31).

version.description: The report version. A consumer must refuse a version it does not know.

environment.description: The Codex variables set in agctl's own process, presence only.

namespaces.description: One entry per owned namespace, in registry order.

orphans.description: Everything under the Codex tree that no record explains.

audit.description: The Codex write log's last lines, oldest first.

notes.description: Sentences about the report as a whole.

path.description: The resolved Codex home; null when it could not be resolved.

symlink_chain.description: The symbolic links walked to reach it, each as `<link> -> <target>`.

error.description: Why the home could not be resolved (fact F86).

mode.description: The configured store mode. `unknown` stands for a value this build does not know: the value itself is file content and is never emitted.

coarse_match.description: Whether a `Codex Auth` item could only be matched by service name, the keychain listing having no account column.

profiles_consulted.description: Always false: a profile cannot set the store key (fact F84).

base_url.description: `chatgpt_base_url`, when it is a plain URL carrying no credential.

config_note.description: What was wrong with `config.toml` — the line NUMBER only, never its text (invariant I31, plan AC116).

present.description: Whether it is set. The value is never emitted.

auth_mode.description: The authentication mode. `unknown` stands for one this build does not know: the spelling is file content.

mode_bits.description: The file's permission bits as four octal digits.

mode_warning.description: Set when the bits are not 0600.

access_expiry.description: The access token's expiry as a relative time.

matches_namespace.description: The owned namespace holding the same grant, as `<user>+<acct>`.

enum: a recycled process id, not the daemon
a daemon record cannot be read

missing_known_members.description: Members of fact F61's field set the document does not have. The names come from this build's own list.

unknown_member_count.description: How many members the document has that are not in that set. A COUNT: the names are file content (premortem PM22).

multi_auth_present.description: Whether the live home has a `multi-auth/` directory. Its contents are never listed and never read (open question U32).

switcher_items.description: How many `codex-switcher:` keychain items are listed. A COUNT: an item's account names a person.

codex_auth_items.description: How many `Codex Auth` keychain items are listed.

unexplained_removals.description: The manual removal command for each listed `Codex Auth` item whose account is not this home's AND is spelled `cli|` plus sixteen lowercase hexadecimal digits — the item a login child may have gained. An account is an attribute any application can set, so a command is built only from a string agctl itself could have written (review S35 C1).

unnameable_items.description: How many further `Codex Auth` items are listed under an account agctl would not have written. A COUNT: the account string is never emitted.

path.description: The namespace directory agctl derives from those two ids.

artefacts.description: What else the directory holds, by kind.

unavailable.description: Why the marker could not be read, as `<path> (<reason>)`.

inflight_digest8.description: The digest prefix of the refresh token a send is outstanding for.

class.description: The class of an unknown outcome, including `interrupted`.

subject.description: The directory name, or the `<user>+<acct>` pair it concerns.
